title: Campaign definition
description: A named set of runs launched together to answer one question. The base is a complete spec. Each named spec is written as its changes from the base and expands to the base with those changes merged in: objects merge key by key, arrays and values replace. A named spec may change only the worker host, the hypervisor, the microVM and the densities; the criteria, the procedure and the support host are set once in the base, so every run is tested and judged the same way. Each spec gets `replicas` runs, each on its own worker host. Run k of spec S is S-rk, and its results go in results/<campaign>/S-rk/.

allOf.x-message: dev is reserved for local runs

name.description: The campaign's name, and its directory under results/.

question.description: The one question the campaign's runs answer together.

replicas.description: How many runs each spec gets, each on its own worker host. Replicas show how much a result varies from host to host.

shutdown_after_minutes.description: Every host shuts itself down this many minutes after it boots, whatever else happens. The worst-case cost assumes every host runs until then. A run still going when it fires stopped early.

base.description: The complete spec every named spec starts from. It is not run by itself: a named spec {} runs it as it is.

specs.description: The campaign's specs by name, in the order written, each holding only its changes from the base.

why.description: Optional: for each spec by name, one sentence on why it is in the campaign. Shown beside the spec.

name.x-message: a name has 2 to 40 lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, and starts with a letter

spec_changes.description: One named spec: its changes from the base.
